title: Car profile
description: One place for the car's engine values and units: the redline, rev scale, cold rev limit, shift lights, warm-up and too-hot temperatures and the speed, distance, temperature, pressure, fuel use, torque and power units. M Vitals, Redline, Warm-Up, Virtual Dyno, Drag Timer, Brake Test, G-Force, eDrive and Transmission Config follow them; what is left to each app stays as each app has it

settings.label: Engine
settings.help: Which engine the apps take the car to have: their gauges and limits follow it (Auto: read from the car; M car: the AK clusters keep clear of its M display's boxes, a plug-in hybrid's of its eDrive box)

settings.label: Yellow light at
settings.help: From here the lights and the rev gauges turn yellow (e.g. 4000)

settings.label: Red light at
settings.help: From here they turn red: the red zone (e.g. 6000; Auto: the redline)

settings.label: Shift now warning at
settings.help: Shift now: the lights flash, the speed and the gear red (e.g. 6500)

settings.label: Gauge goes up to
settings.help: Where the rev gauges end (e.g. 7000)

settings.label: Engine's top rpm (redline)
settings.help: The engine's real limit, where the fuel is cut; Auto is fine

settings.label: Cold rev limit
settings.help: The top rpm while the oil is still cold (30 °C); it climbs to the redline as the oil warms

settings.label: Redline app: light style
settings.help: Shift point: lit only at the shift point; Rev bar: filling from the yellow

settings.label: Cold-engine rev guard
settings.help: On: the shift warning and the red zone come lower while the engine is cold

settings.label: Oil is warm at
settings.help: From this oil temperature the engine counts as warmed up

settings.label: Coolant is warm at
settings.help: From this coolant temperature the engine counts as warmed up

settings.label: Gearbox oil is warm at
settings.help: From this gearbox oil temperature the gearbox counts as warmed up

settings.label: Oil is too hot at
settings.help: From this oil temperature it shows red: too hot

settings.label: Coolant is too hot at
settings.help: From this coolant temperature it shows red: too hot

settings.label: Gearbox is too hot at
settings.help: From this gearbox oil temperature it shows red: too hot

settings.label: Speed unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show speeds in

settings.label: Distance unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show distances and ranges in

settings.label: Temperature unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show temperatures in

settings.label: Pressure unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show boost and tyre pressures in

settings.label: Fuel use unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show fuel economy in

settings.label: Torque unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show torque in

settings.label: Power unit
settings.help: The unit the apps show engine power in

settings.label: Skin
settings.help: The look of the apps' screens: Classic, or as the iDrive 7's own

settings.label: Colour theme
settings.help: The screens' colours (with the Classic skin)

settings.label: Screen layout
settings.help: Full screen: a slim button bar; Standard: the iDrive's usual larger buttons

settings.label: Renderer
settings.help: How the screens are drawn: the GPU (smooth, 60 fps) or the software way (if the GPU gives trouble)

settings.label: Demo data
settings.help: Made-up values to try the screens (Auto: until the car answers)

settings.label: Clock
settings.help: The AK clusters' clock: 12-hour or 24-hour

settings.label: Time zone (the clock)
settings.help: Where the car is, for the AK clusters' clock (the head unit keeps UTC)

settings.label: Fuel tank size
settings.help: The tank's size, to turn the fuel gauge's percent into litres

settings.label: Fuel % from
settings.help: The AK clusters' fuel gauge: the engine unit's own level while the engine runs (the car's litres until then), or the litres over the tank's size always

settings.label: Electric range when full
settings.help: A plug-in hybrid's electric range when full, used until the car's own figure comes

settings.label: G-force circle up to
settings.help: How many g the G-force circles' outer ring stands for

settings.label: Speedometer up to
settings.help: Where the speedometers end: 260 km/h for most BMWs, 330 km/h for an M car

settings.label: Boost gauge up to
settings.help: Where the boost gauges end, as the car's own: 15, 20 or 30 psi (in bar 2.0, in kPa 200), or 45 psi (3.0 bar, 300 kPa). Auto: where the car's own Sport Display's ends (the least at or over it, within 5 %)
